about.title: About Me

about.description1: I'm an M2 Computer Science student at Université Lyon 1, specializing in AI and Data Science. I focus on 3D data, computer vision, and applied AI, especially at the intersection of nutrition and gastronomy.
about.description2: I'm currently looking for PhD opportunities in 3D data, AI, computer vision, and AI for nutrition/gastronomy, and I am also open to full-time engineering positions in these domains. I'm passionate about building useful, human-centered AI solutions from research to deployment.
about.personalInterests: But there's more to me than just code! I'm also a professional chef consultant, lion dance performer, and music enthusiast. These diverse experiences shape my creative approach to problem-solving and bring a unique perspective to my technical work.

projects.title: My Projects
projects.subtitle: Here are some of the projects I've worked on. Each one represents a unique challenge and learning experience.

descriptions.portfolioWebsite: A modern, responsive portfolio website built with React and Tailwind CSS featuring smooth animations and interactive elements.
descriptions.ecommercePlatform: Full-stack e-commerce solution with user authentication, payment processing, and admin dashboard.
descriptions.smartFridge: A smart refrigerator prototype that extends food freshness by monitoring its environment. It integrates humidity, air quality, and temperature sensors for real-time data collection. Implemented with Arduino and modular Java/C++ code for easy customization and scalability.
descriptions.hybridAdventure: A genetics simulation program that uses Mendelian inheritance to plan flower or animal breeding. Choose a target color outcome and trace back the breeding process from an initial color set. Built in Java with a focus on clear genetic visualization.
descriptions.filmSearchingTool: A minimalist web application to browse and search for movies using the TMDB API. Users can explore Top Rated, Upcoming, and Popular films, search by title, and view posters with essential info. Built for speed and clarity using modern front-end tools.
descriptions.chickenInvadersClone: A classic 2D space shooter game inspired by Chicken Invaders. Built from scratch in Java using the Java Swing library, the game features waves of enemies, projectile mechanics, collision detection, and score tracking. Designed for educational purposes and to reinforce object-oriented programming concepts.
descriptions.gymnate: A responsive and modern fitness web app that helps users discover workout programs and gyms. Designed with a focus on clean UI/UX and mobile accessibility, it offers category-based filtering, animated transitions, and an engaging landing page to promote healthy lifestyles.
descriptions.cryptoXTracker: A modern and responsive web application that tracks real-time cryptocurrency prices and market statistics. Users can view detailed charts, search for specific coins, and access key metrics such as price, market cap, and 24h changes. Designed to be fast, mobile-friendly, and visually appealing.
descriptions.unityProceduralProject: An advanced Unity project showcasing procedural animation and map generation techniques to create immersive and dynamic game environments. The project includes humanoid and non-human creature animations, reactive rigging systems, and terrain generation logic that produces a unique game map every session. It also integrates advanced gameplay mechanics like boss behavior and procedural weapon animation for enriched interactivity.
descriptions.airmiumSystem: Analyzed data workflows and user requirements, Designed and implemented a secure, scalable system for data historization and quality control, Developed web interfaces for accessing and visualizing real-time air treatment data, Proposed solutions for backup strategies and mobile/web accessibility.
descriptions.edgeDetectionProject: This project implements advanced edge detection techniques using differential operators (Prewitt, Sobel, Kirsch) combined with thresholding and refinement processes to highlight contours in images.
descriptions.visionTransformer: This project explores the capabilities of Vision Transformers (ViTs) by segmenting images into fixed-size patches and attempting to reconstruct the original image using attention-based mechanisms. By experimenting with small patch permutations (e.g., 4×4), the model evaluates whether global context can be preserved and restored from shuffled or occluded image segments. The goal is to investigate the effectiveness of transformer attention in recovering image structure, paving the way for applications in image inpainting, resizing, or restoration.
descriptions.cookingAssistant: Inventory Culinary Assistance project progress: completed Step 1 - Vision & Ingestion Pipeline (#1), Step 2 - Dynamic Inventory & Flavor Matrix (#2), Neo4j knowledge graph architecture and automated ingestion pipeline (#5), and scaling the Culinary Philosophy dataset with supervised fine-tuning (#9). I am currently gathering data for the next step.
descriptions.foodMining: A comprehensive food data analysis platform designed to identify and characterize culinary cultures from over 250,000 recipes from Food.com. Developed data mining modules for extraction, structuring, and large-scale visualization of food data. Implemented classification and clustering algorithms to reveal cultural trends, nutritional habits, and correlations between ingredients, dishes, and regions. Future development includes integration of nutritional aspects related to traditional Asian medicine.
descriptions.biomedicalRNN: A biomedical text classifier based on Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN) using PyTorch. Designed and trained natural language processing models to extract and categorize textual information from specialized biomedical corpora. Implemented complete pipelines for preprocessing, vectorization, and evaluation on real-world datasets. Achieved high accuracy on scientific abstract classification and automatic identification of medical themes, demonstrating model robustness in real-world contexts.
descriptions.fashionNumbers: Development of an image classification model using neural networks for automatic identification of fashion items and digits from standard datasets (Fashion MNIST, MNIST). Designed preprocessing and data augmentation pipelines to improve model robustness. Evaluated on real test sets with excellent accuracy rates, demonstrating the model's effectiveness for visual recognition in varied contexts.
descriptions.graphML: Graph Machine Learning project focusing on link prediction using Graph Autoencoders (GAE) and Variational Graph Autoencoders (VGAE) with rigorous evaluation and reproducible experimentation. Implemented GAE/VGAE encoders and inner-product decoders for node embeddings and edge likelihoods, optimized training with careful split design and metric tracking (AUC, AP). Built strong classical baselines with Jaccard and Preferential Attachment using NetworkX. Designed ablation studies including Linear-VGAE, feature subsets, and featureless identity inputs to isolate topology vs attributes. Benchmarked models across multiple train/val/test ratios to assess robustness and data-efficiency of deterministic vs variational encoders.
descriptions.argumentationDynamics: Development of a complete framework for Assumption-Based Argumentation with preference extensions (ABA+). Integration of a fine-tuned DeBERTa-v2 model for automatic attack detection. Implementation of a flexible parser, normalization algorithms (cycle elimination, flattening, atomization), and generation of minimal arguments via forward chaining. Computation of attacks according to formal ABA+ semantics, distinguishing normal attacks and reversed attacks by preference. Multi-format web interface with structured tables and interactive PyVis graphs.
descriptions.reinforcementLearning: Development of a series of advanced projects around intelligent agents and reinforcement learning using Python and Jupyter Notebook. Implementation of search algorithms, Deep Q-Networks (DQN), and policy evaluation strategies in simulated environments (Pacman, direct search). Utilization of Markov Decision Processes (MDP), value iteration, and Q-learning for solving complex sequential decision-making tasks. Experimental analysis and performance optimization of agents for multi-agent systems and machine learning scenarios.

items.position: AI & 3D Computer Vision Intern – LiDAR Point Cloud Segmentation for BIM Generation
items.description: AI Research Intern working on 3D point cloud segmentation for automatic BIM model generation in dense railway environments.
responsibilities: Conducting literature reviews on 3D semantic and instance segmentation methods for LiDAR point clouds.
Designing and building a labeled dataset for dense railway scenes (stations, multi-track areas).
Defining annotation schemas and developing an annotation workflow with quality control.
Developing and training deep learning models for 3D segmentation.
Implementing preprocessing pipelines including normalization, sampling, and 3D data augmentation.
Evaluating model performance using metrics such as mIoU, precision, recall, and inference time.
Working with tools such as Python, PyTorch, PDAL, and computer vision libraries.
Contributing to the automation of BIM model generation from LiDAR scans for railway infrastructure.

items.description: Developed a secure data management system for air measurement and treatment tools. Designed a PostgreSQL database, built a Spring Boot backend, and created a responsive web interface for data access, automation, and historization — replacing manual Excel processes.

Led and contributed to academic projects including a Vision Transformer image restoration model, a CO₂ emission simulation web app (React/Spring Boot), distributed systems simulations (JBotSim), and multi-agent game theory simulations.

philosophy.title: Culinary Philosophy
philosophy.quote: Cooking is like programming - both require patience, precision, and the ability to blend different elements into something beautiful and functional.
philosophy.description: My approach to cooking mirrors my approach to development. Every ingredient has a purpose, every technique serves a function, and the end result should nourish both body and soul. Just as I write clean, maintainable code, I create dishes that respect tradition while embracing innovation.

intro.title: Traditional Lion Dance
intro.description: Lion dance is more than performance - it's cultural preservation, athletic art, and spiritual practice combined. Through years of training and performance, I've learned the discipline, teamwork, and cultural respect that this ancient art demands.
intro.definition: Lion dance is a traditional performance across Chinese and many Southeast Asian communities. Two dancers animate a lion costume with expressive head and tail work, footwork, and acrobatic jumps to the rhythm of drums, cymbals, and gong. The dance symbolizes good fortune and is performed at festivals, ceremonies, and grand openings.
intro.personal: Lion dance trains my discipline and work ethic. Repetition, conditioning, and the courage to get back up after a fall make me more resilient and focused — on stage and in life.

intro.title: Musical Expression
intro.description: Music has always been a bridge between my Vietnamese heritage and my life in France. Through both Western and traditional Vietnamese instruments, I explore the universal language that connects all cultures.

life.title: On Life & Growth
life.quote: Every skill I learn, every culture I embrace, makes me a more complete developer and human being.
life.description: I believe that diversity of experience leads to innovation. My background in cooking teaches me patience and precision. Lion dance shows me the power of teamwork and cultural respect. Music connects me to emotions and creativity. All of these inform how I approach technology and problem-solving.

work.title: On Technology & Purpose
work.description: Technology should serve humanity, not the other way around. Just as I cook to nourish people and perform to preserve culture, I code to create solutions that make people's lives better. Every project is an opportunity to blend technical excellence with human empathy.

cultural.title: Cultural Bridge Building
cultural.description: Living between Vietnamese heritage and French culture, working with international teams, performing traditional arts - all of these experiences teach me that the best solutions come from understanding and respecting different perspectives. In code, as in life, diversity is strength.
